lewisShort.quote: to speak well of any one, to commend, praise

renderings.words: shall all the kindred of the earth be blessed
shall all families of the earth be blessed
shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed

debate.text: The verb {original} is {grammar}. This stem can be passive ("will be blessed") or reflexive ("will bless themselves", that is, use Abram's name in blessing). The Septuagint {lxx} and the Vulgate {vulgate} are both passive, as are the English versions here.
